text.title: FreshDrop click-and-collect, Moscow, 2022–2026
text.stages: Introduction 2022, growth 2023–2024, maturity from 2025: growth under 3% a quarter
text.now: Maturity: orders +2% a quarter, margin 9%, new customers 11% of orders
text.decision: Extend: add a family bundle for the new market. Do not exit: margin is above 0
text.result: Bundle tested in 2 districts from 1 July; check new-customer share in 8 weeks
